children: Exchange Bank is proud to announce Morgan Steele, Vice President, Senior Compliance Officer, has received a Certificate of Congressional Recognition from the United States House of Representatives in honor of her significant contributions and service to Compassion Planet during National Volunteer Week.
This press release features multimedia. View the full release here: https://www.businesswire.com/news/home/20261116365477/en/

California’s Third Congressional District recognized Steele for her dedication to making a positive impact and for her outstanding and invaluable service to the community. Through her volunteer work with Compassion Planet, Steele helps empower aged-out foster youth and young people from at-risk backgrounds to achieve independence, overcome personal obstacles, and reach their fullest potential.

Steele works directly with youth, providing mentorship and practical workplace training designed to help them build confidence and develop skills for future employment. Her volunteer efforts include teaching customer service, technology skills, cash register operation and cash management, as well as helping participants strengthen their résumés and prepare for job interviews.

By sharing her time, knowledge and professional experience, Steele helps young people gain the tools and confidence needed to enter the workforce and pursue opportunities within their own communities.

Steele said, “This work is important to me because every young person deserves to feel supported, capable and hopeful about their future. Sometimes, having someone who believes in you and takes the time to share their knowledge can make a meaningful difference. I’m grateful for the opportunity to help these young people build practical skills, gain confidence and recognize their own potential. Watching them grow and prepare for the next chapter of their lives is incredibly rewarding.”

Her recognition reflects the meaningful difference that dedicated volunteers can make in the lives of young people as they navigate the transition to adulthood and work toward a more independent future.

“At Exchange Bank, we believe that strong communities are built when people invest in one another,” said Jamie Hidalgo, Senior Vice President Risk Management Officer. “Morgan’s commitment to mentoring young people and helping them develop the skills they need to succeed is a wonderful example of that belief in action. We are proud to see her dedication to service recognized and grateful for the positive impact she continues to make in our community.”
Exchange Bank congratulates Steele on this well-deserved recognition and thanks her for the time, compassion and expertise she shares with young people through her work with Compassion Planet.

Headquartered in Sonoma County and founded in 1890, Exchange Bank is a full-service community bank with assets over $3.30 billion. The Bank offers a comprehensive range of personal and business banking services including personal and business financing, and Trust and Investment Management services. Exchange Bank serves customers through 19 retail branches across the North Bay and Roseville, along with Trust & Investment Management offices located in Santa Rosa, Roseville, Marin County, and Silicon Valley.

Exchange Bank’s long-standing legacy of financial leadership and community support is grounded in its core values of commitment, respect, integrity, and teamwork. The Bank is known for its people—professionals who care deeply about their customers, their colleagues, and the communities where they live and work.

Exchange Bank is a 21-time recipient of the North Bay Business Journal’s Best Places to Work award and a 15-time winner of Best Bank of Sonoma County in the Press Democrat Readers’ Choice Awards (2026). Additional honors include Best Consumer Bank by NorthBay biz Magazine’s Best of the North Bay readers’ poll and Best Local Bank by The Petaluma Argus-Courier People’s Choice Awards (2026). Exchange Bank also received the 2026 San Francisco Business Times Corporate Philanthropy Award, and Bohemian Magazine’s Best of the North Bay 2026 named the Bank both Best Business Bank and Best Consumer Bank.
Exchange Bank also earned national recognition as one of America’s Best Regional Banks by Newsweek.
